items.title: Sister Bernice Phillips Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: Dude was working with Joe Avery and the trombone play. I remember that.

ctx.x: I don't think Foster was dead then. Cause I think Dude died ahead of Foster. Might be. Yeah. Because Foster used to live in 8th and Ramport. And Dude died ahead of him.
Dude was working with Joe Avery and the trombone play. I remember that.
And you know, he used to work with my husband too. Dude did. Mmhmm. And this fella from up in Calden, you know him, he used to play a... stuff
